creators.name: Imogen Heap
creators.role: Musician, producer and music-technology inventor (Mi.Mu gloves)
creators.bio: Grammy-winning English singer-songwriter and producer who co-developed the Mi.Mu gesture-controlled music gloves and has performed electronic music through body movement for more than a decade.
creators.why: She has spent years turning gestures into music, and her SPECS Sound Space shows what that body-as-instrument idea becomes when the instruments float visibly in the air.
creators.role_zh: 音乐人、制作人、音乐科技发明者（Mi.Mu 手套）
creators.bio_zh: 获得格莱美奖的英国创作歌手和制作人，参与研发了用手势控制音乐的 Mi.Mu 手套，十多年来一直用身体动作来演奏电子音乐。
creators.why_zh: 她多年来把手势变成音乐；SPECS 上的 Sound Space 展示了当乐器真的漂浮在空中、被看见时，“身体即乐器”的想法会变成什么样。

creators.name: LePub Singapore (LeGarage)
creators.role: Creative agency in the Publicis network, with its innovation unit LeGarage
creators.bio: Singapore office of the Publicis-owned creative agency LePub; its LeGarage innovation team builds technology-led campaigns such as Augmented Reading for the National Library Board.
creators.why: It used AR glasses to argue for slow reading on paper instead of replacing books with screens.
creators.role_zh: Publicis 集团旗下创意代理公司，设有创新部门 LeGarage
creators.bio_zh: Publicis 旗下创意公司 LePub 的新加坡办公室；其创新团队 LeGarage 专做以技术驱动的项目，例如为新加坡国家图书馆管理局打造的 Augmented Reading。
creators.why_zh: 它用 AR 眼镜为纸本慢读辩护，而不是用屏幕取代书本。

works.title: Sound Space (SPECS x Imogen Heap)
works.description: On the SPECS launch stage, Imogen Heap improvises a song inside a sound space she designed: instruments float around her body, and she plays, loops, mixes and adds reverb to them with hand gestures and her voice.
works.description_zh: 在 SPECS 发布会的舞台上，Imogen Heap 在她亲手设计的“声音空间”里即兴创作一首歌：乐器漂浮在她身体四周，她用手势和嗓音演奏、循环、混音，并随手加上混响。
works.idea_en: Treat the body as the instrument: the air around the performer becomes a visible loop station played with gestures and voice.
works.idea_zh: 把身体当作乐器：表演者周围的空气变成一台看得见、靠手势和嗓音演奏的循环工作站。
works.technique: Hand tracking on SPECS maps gestures such as grabbing, opening a hand and raising an arm to record, loop, volume and effect controls on world-anchored instrument objects, while the microphones capture voice loops; the gesture vocabulary continues her Mi.Mu gloves (likely built together with Snap's Lens Studio team).
works.technique_zh: SPECS 的手部追踪把抓取、张开手掌、抬手等动作映射到锚定在空间中的乐器上，控制录音、循环、音量和效果，麦克风同时采集人声循环；这套手势语汇延续了她的 Mi.Mu 手套（很可能是与 Snap 的 Lens Studio 团队合作开发）。
works.exercise_en: Build a hand-tracked loop station in Lens Studio or WebXR: three floating spheres each record two seconds of microphone audio while you pinch them and loop it when you let go. Twist: the height of your hand sets each loop's volume, so the performance becomes a visible sculpture of sound.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 WebXR 做一个手势循环工作站：空中漂浮三个球，捏住时录下两秒麦克风声音，松手后循环播放；变体：手的高度决定每个循环的音量，让整场表演变成一座看得见的声音雕塑。

works.title: Augmented Reading (National Library Board Singapore)
works.description: For the National Library Board of Singapore, readers wear Spectacles over a printed classic such as Pride and Prejudice or Frankenstein; as they read, images tied to the passage float into view and sound effects such as a creaking door play at the right words.
works.description_zh: 为新加坡国家图书馆管理局打造：读者戴上 Spectacles 阅读《傲慢与偏见》《弗兰肯斯坦》等纸质经典，读到哪里，与段落相关的画面就飘到眼前，读到某些词时还会响起开门声之类的音效。
works.idea_en: Keep reading on paper, but let the story appear and sound around the book in time with your reading.
works.idea_zh: 依旧读纸质书，但让故事随着阅读的进度在书的周围显现、发出声音。
works.technique: Real-time OCR reads the printed page through the glasses' camera; machine learning and generative AI match each passage to illustrations and sound cues, shown in AR and played through the stereo speakers.
works.technique_zh: 眼镜摄像头用实时 OCR 读取纸质书页，机器学习和生成式 AI 为每段文字匹配插图和音效，画面在 AR 中显示，声音由眼镜的立体声扬声器播放。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone prototype that recognises a printed keyword such as 'rain' or 'door' with OCR and plays a matching sound and image above the page. Twist: the illustration changes with the reader's speed, calm when they read slowly and frantic when they skim.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机原型：用 OCR 识别书页上的关键词（如“雨”或“门”），在书页上方播放对应的声音和图像；变体：插图随阅读速度变化，读得慢时安静，匆匆浏览时变得躁动。

leads.name: Paradiddle (Drum Kit on Specs)
leads.why: VR drum studio whose Spectacles Drum Kit overlays lessons on a real drum set; named by Snap in 2025 and 2026 launch posts, but no Specs video found yet.

leads.name: Headraft (Cookmate)
leads.why: Hamburg studio behind Cookmate, an AI cooking assistant on Spectacles that recognises ingredients and guides each step hands-free; only a podcast video found.

leads.name: Gowaaa (Super Travel)
leads.why: Singapore AR studio whose Super Travel Lens translates signs and menus and converts prices on Spectacles; no demo video found.

leads.name: Wabisabi Games (Doggo Quest)
leads.why: Spectacles Lens that recognises your dog with SnapML and turns walks into a quest with rewards (March 2025 OS update); no standalone video found.

leads.name: Paramount: Avatar: The Last Airbender Lens
leads.why: Airbending training Lens on Spectacles (2025): push air with head turns and hand gestures to knock down targets; its only video is shared with ILM's Holocron Histories.

leads.name: Charles Pétillon (AR Studio Paris residency)
leads.why: First artist in Snap AR Studio Paris' Spectacles residency (May 2025), an installation about the meeting of real and virtual worlds; already a creator in the gallery, no Spectacles video found.

leads.name: RefractAR (Lauren Cason & Sam Jones)
leads.why: Studio co-founded by ex-Meow Wolf XR creative director Lauren Cason that builds games and remote-location features for Spectacles; only a Snap profile video found.

leads.name: NBA / WNBA basketball experience on SPECS
leads.why: Shooting-form training app built with the NBA and WNBA for the 2026 SPECS launch; no dedicated video yet.

leads.name: Vector Fields (SPECS education Lens)
leads.why: Education Lens named at the AWE 2026 SPECS reveal that makes magnetic fields and airflow around a wing visible; developer and video not yet found.

leads.name: Chen Ji, Corina Sas & Katherine Isbister (TouchEmotion)
leads.why: TOCHI 2025 paper: three Spectacles prototypes that use metaphorical emotional trajectories and touchpad input to regulate anxiety, anger and boredom; no public video found.

leads.name: Feifei Shen & Wei Wu (Oral Histories to Play, Northeastern)
leads.why: FDG 2026 paper turning Boston Chinatown oral histories into three site-specific AR encounters on Spectacles; no public video found.

leads.name: Diya Hundiwala & Andrés Monroy-Hernández (AnchorNote)
leads.why: 2026 Princeton study: spoken ideas become spatially anchored sticky notes via live transcription and LLM summaries for co-located brainstorming; device and video not confirmed.

leads.name: Xia Zheng, Floris Roelofsen et al. (Augmented Remote Sign Language Interpreting)
leads.why: 2025 University of Amsterdam study where a remote sign-language interpreter sees the deaf user's view through Spectacles '24 and appears in their glasses; no public video found.

leads.name: RCA x Snap Augmented UnRealities
leads.why: Royal College of Art programme where student teams build public-exhibition AR works on Spectacles; programme video exists but individual projects are not documented yet.

leads.name: Niantic Spatial x Liquid City (Peridot VPS agent demo, AWE 2025)
leads.why: Spectacles demo of a place-aware Peridot guide; it is the same work as Liquid City's Project Jade already in the gallery.

leads.name: OHI Studio Airmeter
leads.why: Studio ANRK/OHI app that shows live PM2.5 and NO2 levels from a street sensor as AR (phone 2024, Ray-Ban 2026), not on Spectacles; worth adding to Anrick Bregman's phone AR works.

leads.name: Vincent Guigui (Lyrics Everywhere)
leads.why: Spectacles Lens (2025) that turns song lyrics into diegetic objects: a rabbit holding a sign, a plane towing a banner, speech bubbles over passers-by synced to the music, dance steps at your feet.
